name: Golden Desire: Fantasy Romance
storyline:
"The god who wins her heart will be crowned the greatest of all."
I woke up in the Forest of Gods, my past a distant blur. Guided by Hades, the enigmatic God of the Underworld, I soon find myself inside a divine palace, surrounded by radiant gods. But everything changes when the gods notice the golden inscription glowing on my collarbone:
[To the greatest god.]
This simple phrase throws the realm of the gods into chaos. Who among them is truly the greatest? Debates rage, egos clash, and celestial tensions rise—until a bold challenge is proposed:
"Let her choice decide who deserves the title of the greatest god."
Now, four divine gods compete to win my heart, each offering love, devotion, and breathtaking romance in their own unique way. Will my choices lead to eternal love, balance, or unexpected twists?
Inspired by Greek mythology’s golden apple, Golden Desire is adventure where every choice shapes my divine fate!
summary: Whoever wins your heart will be crowned the greatest god of all! Step into a high-fantasy otome world, filled with Greek mythology-inspired ikemen gods and breathtaking romance. Unlock stunning illustrations that capture the most magical, romantic, and emotional moments. Your choices determine multiple endings—will your romance lead to love, balance, or divine conflict?
